in_sanskrit.name: लक्ष्मीकान्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who holds the Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity, in his heart.

in_hindi.name: लक्ष्मीकान्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: लक्ष्मी (लक्ष्मी) के साथ रहने वाला कान्त (कान्त)

in_marathi.name: Laxmikanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth, Fortune and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Laxmikanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Laxmi is the Hindu goddess of wealth, fortune, prosperity, and the embodiment of beauty, fertility, and the bestower of earthly pleasures. Kanta refers to Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe.

in_bengali.name: Laxmikanta
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Wealth, Fortune and Prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Laxmikanta একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Laxmi is the Hindu goddess of wealth, fortune, prosperity, and the embodiment of beauty, fertility, and the bestower of earthly pleasures. Kanta refers to Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe.
